Three more songs join the surprises, an old favourite gets a few more, and some surprises can now be touched.

## New

- **More surprises.** Three more songs the developer loves now come with something extra, and one of the first ones got a little more. Play them and see.
- **Stickers you can move.** When a surprise puts stickers around the cover, pick one up and drag it anywhere in the player. Flick it and it slides. They go back to the cover the next time the surprise starts.

## Improved

- **The pauses between lyrics fit the song.** In some surprises, the dots between lines become little shapes that match the song.

## Fixed

- **A surprise no longer covers the song title** at the top of the player.

## Good to know

- **Lyrics can show a translation and romanization.** When a song's lyrics include them, tap the translate button below the lyrics to show or hide them.
- **Stickers stay out of the way.** A tap on a sticker still reaches the button under it, and swiping down outside a sticker still closes the player. If Remove animations is on in your Android settings, stickers still move but don't slide.
- **Some surprises flash or shake the screen for a moment.** If Remove animations is on, the screen does not shake.
- **Double tap anywhere to stop a surprise.** It also ends by itself when the song does.
